bar.name: v1 HTML fixtures and A2UI for the same apps; 300 blind English requests; independent end-to-end attack on stored rows

biggest_gap: Statement identity is still positional for components. Timers and forms expand to inner statements numbered by position, so swapping or inserting a timer hands a running timer to another one; in Pomodoro the wrong end action then adds a session nobody earned.

acceptance.line: >= 90% of 300 blind requests expressible (programs parse and type-check)
acceptance.evidence: 330 of 330 programs check. Coverage of unseen requests not re-measured.
300 corpus programs: keyword tokenizer median 133, p90 239, max 811.

acceptance.line: every prefix cut at a line end parses
acceptance.evidence: Prefix test passes in the builder suite (577 of 578; the one failure is the 20,000-row speed test under load).

acceptance.line: edits never lose or retype saved data while marked safe
acceptance.evidence: Rows and settings survived every safe edit. But safe edits hand a running timer to another timer (S1 in Pomodoro), reset per-item each counters when the each gains sort/where/top or its table is renamed (S2), and lose unsent form drafts when forms are added or reordered (S2).

other_notes: S2: after a `when` condition is edited its edge stays true, so the new condition never fires until a tick; in catch-up a `when` whose action makes its own condition false is evaluated once per fire and then skipped (best = 1 instead of 10).

Fixed and confirmed from round 10: true `when` no longer re-fires after a heading edit, stale row index after Undo, catch-up early stop, fingerprint, idle timer length, restore migration, shared block state, afters and Undo, rule interleaving.
Speed at 2,000 rows under load 19: tree 25 to 117 ms, tap plus tree 22 to 126 ms. Critic's lockstep fuzz 145k steps on 38 programs: 0 real violations; neither fuzzer reorders timers or forms.
